summary_md: **Olli Sorjonen ([@Olmirad](https://x.com/Olmirad/status/2115923666651287685))** made an experimental ComfyUI wrapper for NVIDIA's **Open-H3-Regenerate-2K** upscaler with adjustable noise and memory controls; lower noise adds texture and sharpness, though faces, text and small details can drift, and after first dismissing it as close to SoL-Refiner he now sees use cases ([o-l-l-i/ComfyUI-Olm-Open-H3-Regenerate-2K](https://github.com/o-l-l-i/ComfyUI-Olm-Open-H3-Regenerate-2K)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - o-l-l-i/ComfyUI-Olm-Open-H3-Regenerate-2K: Experimental ComfyUI nodes for NVIDIA's Open-H3-Regenerate-2K for upscaling and generatively refining video, or existing MiniMax-H3 latents.

relevance: Open upscaling/refinement node for local image pipelines.
